title: Sixteen Ribs Held Up by Nothing
subtitle: 艺术殿堂 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 艺术殿堂（文学艺术与体育·音乐与建筑）
meta: 主题语境：艺术殿堂（文学艺术与体育·音乐与建筑）　|　核心词汇：structure　|　正文 359 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 structure 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: The hall was built in 1901 as a ① structure of steel and glass, and everybody in the town said it would fall down inside a year. It has stood for a hundred and twenty. The ② structure of the roof is exactly what it was in 1901, and every engineer who comes to look at it says the only thing wrong with it is that nobody has ever drawn the structure properly.

The ③ structure is held up by sixteen ribs, and each rib is held up by nothing at all, which is the trick of it and the reason it has never been copied. Inside, the ④ structure of the sound is the same trick in another material: a note goes out from the platform and comes back off the glass a fifth of a second later, and the ear hears two notes where the hand played one.

For eleven years the woman who ran the hall ⑤ structured the whole season herself, three concerts a month from October to June, and she never once put a symphony before Christmas. The ⑥ structure she built around it — tickets by post, seats unnumbered, no interval — was, she said, not a plan but a promise, and no structure, she added, survives the person who built it.

She used to say a concert hall is a ⑦ social structure before it is a building, and that the town came to be told what to listen to and stayed to be told what to think. Her programme notes were famous; the ⑧ sentence structure of them was, one critic wrote, closer to law than to English, and she took that as a compliment and had it reprinted.

When she died the hall was closed for a year and reopened with the ⑨ structure painted, which she had refused to allow for eleven years, and with the seats numbered, which she had refused outright. She had said that structure was not hers to change. The ⑩ structure of the first concert back was unchanged: three pieces, no interval, and a note that goes out and comes back. I was there. The ribs are still held up by nothing at all.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 结构；构造（实体的构造方式）
B. n. 建筑物；大型构筑物
C. n. （乐曲、作品、文章的）结构；布局
D. n. 体系；体制；组织架构
E. v. 组织；安排；规划
F. 固定搭配：sentence / grammar structure 句子／语法结构
G. 固定搭配：social / power structure 社会／权力结构
H. 固定搭配：the structure of ... ……的结构

items.q: as a structure of steel and glass
The structure of the roof is exactly what it was
The structure is held up by sixteen ribs
the structure of the sound is the same trick
The structure she built around it
a concert hall is a social structure before it is
the sentence structure of them was, one critic wrote
The structure of the first concert back was unchanged

answers.why: a structure 意为“建筑物、构筑物”，这座音乐厅 1901 年建成时是一座钢铁与玻璃的建筑。
the structure of the roof 意为“屋顶的结构”，屋顶的结构与 1901 年时一模一样。
the structure 意为“（整个的）结构、构造”，整座建筑由十六根肋架撑起。
the structure of the sound 意为“声音的结构、声场布局”，声音的结构是同一种手法换了一种材料。
structured 是动词，意为“组织、安排、规划”，她自己安排了整整十一个演出季。
the structure 意为“体系、组织架构”，她围绕演出季建立起来的是一整套办法。
a social structure 意为“社会结构、社会体系”，她说音乐厅先是社会结构，其次才是房子。
sentence structure 意为“句子结构”，有评论家说她节目单上的句子结构更像法律条文而非英文。
the structure 意为“（建筑的）结构”，重开时把建筑结构刷了漆，这是她十一年里一直不许的。
the structure of the first concert 意为“第一场音乐会的结构、节目布局”，重开后的第一场音乐会结构照旧。
